settings.shipping_text:
Free delivery all over Pakistan on every order. Cash on Delivery is available. Orders usually arrive in 3 to 5 working days to major cities and 5 to 7 working days elsewhere.

No returns are accepted. If your item arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, tell us within 48 hours with photos and we will replace it.
